chapter.verse: Tu-in Topa in Abram’ kiangah, “Na gam leh na beh leh na pa’ inn panin nang kong lah ding gamah pai in.
Thupha a ngah dingin minam lian khatin nang hong bawlin, thupha hong pia-in, na min kong liansak ding a, nang in thupha na hi ding hi.
Nang thupha hong piate thupha ka pia ding a, nang hong samsia mi ka samsia ding hi; nang’ tung tawnin leitung innkuan khempeuh in thupha ngah ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa ’ gensa bangin Abram pai hi; Lot in zong amah zui hi. Haran panin a paikhiat-in Abram kum sawmsagih-le-nga pha hi.

Abram in ama’ zi Sarai, a sanggampa’ tapa Lot, amau’ kaihkhopsa neihsa khempeuh leh Haran-a amau’ neih mi khempeuh sam a, Kanaan gamah pai dingin amaute dingkhia uh hi. Amaute Kanaan gam a tun’ uh ciangin,
Abram in tua gam nawkin Shekhem mun, Moreth tawsaw phung tung hi. Tua hunin tua gamah Kanaan mite teng lai hi.
Tua ciangin Abram’ tungah Topa kilang a, “Na suan-le-khakte' tungah hih leitang ka pia ding hi,” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in ama' tunga kilang Topa adingin biakna tau khat bawl hi.

Tua ciangin Beth-el panin nisuahna lam mual-ah amah kin kikin, a puanbuk lam a, nitumna lamah Beth-el, nisuahna lamah Ai om hi; tua lai munah zong amah in Topa ’ adingin biaknatau khat bawl a, Topa ’ tungah thungen hi.
Abram in a khualzin zom lai a, Negeb gam lam manawhin pai lai hi.
Tu-in gamsungah kialpi tung hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua gamah kialpi nasia ahih manin Abram tawlkhat sung a om dingin Izipt-ah paisuk hi.
Izipt gam a tum ding ciangin amah in a zi Sarai’ kiangah, “Nang pen, a melhoih numei khat na hihna ka thei hi;
Izipt mite in nang hong muh ciangin amaute in, ‘Hih nu in ama zi ahi hi,’ ci ding uh hi; tua ciangin amaute in kei hong that ding uh a, ahi zongin amaute in nang hong nungtasak ding uh hi.
Nang pen ka sanggamnu ci lehang, nangma’ hangin kei’ adingin thu hong hoihzaw ding a, nangma’ hangin ka suakta thei kha ding hi,” ci hi.
Izipt gamsungah Abram a tun ciangin Izipt mite in tua nu pen melhoih mahmah hi ci-in mu uh hi.
Faro’ uliante in amah a muh uh ciangin Faro’ kiangah amah phat uh hi. Faro’ inn sungah tua nu kila hi.
Tua nu’ hangin amah in Abram limbawl mahmah hi; amah in tuu, bawngtal, la-tal, pasal-nasem, numei-nasem, la-nu, leh kalaohte pia hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Abram’ zi Sarai’ huhau-in Faro leh a innkuanpihte gimna lianpi thuaksak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro in Abram samin, “Kei tunga nong bawlna hih thu in bang ahi hiam? Amah na zi a hihna bang hang in kei kiangah hong gen lo na hi hiam?
Ka zi dingin amah ka lak theih nadingin, ‘Amah in ka sanggamnu hi,’ bang hangin ci na hi hiam? Tu-in hih lai-ah na zi om hi, amah la in la pai un,” ci hi.
Faro in amah tawh kisai-in a mite' tungah thupia hi; amaute in a zi leh ama' neih khempeuh tawh lampi-ah amah kha uh hi.
